select ID as id,`NAME` as name,DEPT as dept,DEPT_ID as deptId,ID_NUMBER as idNumber,'1' as userType,'' as insUnit,MAJOR as eduMajor,'' as graduateDate from PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and `STATUS` = '0'
and `NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')
union all select ID as id,`NAME` as name,DEPT as dept,DEPT_ID as deptId,ID_NUMBER as idNumber,'2' as userType,INS_UNIT as insUnit,MAJOR as eduMajor,'' as graduateDate from HR_SUB_PERSONNEL where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' and HR_STATUS='0' and `STATUS` in ('0','1')
and `NAME` like CONCAT('%', #{param.name}, '%')

select a.* from (select * , CASE WHEN VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) then '临近六个月' WHEN VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) then '临近三个月' WHEN VALIDITY IS NOT NULL AND VALIDITY <= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) then '临近一个月' ELSE '' END AS certStage from HR_CERT_MANAGE where DELETE_FLAG='NOT_DELETE' ) a ${ew.customSqlSegment}
